input: Read /data/export.tsv which is tab-separated with columns: id, last_name, first_name, email, department. Convert it to /data/import.csv (comma-separated) with columns reordered to: email, first_name, last_name, department (dropping the id column). Include a header row. Print the result.

transcript.final_response:
Converted `/data/export.tsv` → `/data/import.csv` with reordered columns `email,first_name,last_name,department`:

```
email,first_name,last_name,department
alice@co.com,Alice,Smith,Eng
bob@co.com,Bob,Jones,Sales
carol@co.com,Carol,Davis,Eng
dave@co.com,Dave,Wilson,HR
```
tool_calls:
python3 -c '
import csv
with open("/data/export.tsv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fin, open("/data/import.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fout:
    reader = csv.DictReader(fin, delimiter="\t")
    writer = csv.writer(fout, delimiter=",", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["email", "first_name", "last_name", "department"])
    for row in reader:
        writer.writerow([row["email"], row["first_name"], row["last_name"], row["department"]])
'
cat /data/import.csv
